content: {"like":["Enjoys low‑brow, chuckle‑provoking humor in 1980s comedy films like *Hot Tub Time Machine*","Prefers long‑running sitcoms with strong, charismatic casts such as *Bewitched*","Values well‑executed superhero portrayals and coherent pacing in modern blockbusters like *Wonder Woman*","Appreciates procedural crime dramas with clever cases and solid team dynamics, e.g., *Major Crimes*","Likes superhero series with attractive young casts and upbeat themes, as seen in *Supergirl*"],"dislike":["Dislikes implausible time‑travel premises and vulgar, homophobic humor in 1980s comedies","Rejects repetitive plots and cast fatigue in long‑running sitcoms","Criticizes over‑long CGI battles and cheesy tone in contemporary superhero films","Finds unrealistic procedural details and weak character arcs in crime dramas frustrating","Dislikes sappy, sentimental focus on love and family in superhero series"]}
